steps.title: Seed HEK293 cells for IP
steps.instruction: Plate 2 × 10⁵ HEK293 cells in 2 mL DMEM (high glucose) containing 10 % FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin per well of a 6‑well plate; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified.

steps.title: Lyse cells and collect lysate
steps.instruction: Remove medium, add 250 µL ice‑cold 1 % Triton X‑100 lysis buffer (see Recipes) to each well, gently shake to cover the surface, transfer to a 1.5 mL tube on ice and centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. Keep the supernatant; retain 10 µL as input fraction for western blot.

steps.title: Prepare input fraction for blot
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL 6× SDS‑dye to the 10 µL input, incubate at 95 °C for 5 min, then store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Make 10× antibody‑RNase A mix
steps.instruction: Combine in a tube: 18.8 µL freshly prepared 1 % Triton X‑100 lysis buffer, 1 µL anti‑ribosomal P0/P1/P2 mAb (0.05 µg/µL), 0.2 µL RNase A (100 mg/mL, 1 mg/mL). Mix well; this is the 10× antibody solution.

steps.title: Incubate lysate with antibody mix
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of the 10× antibody‑RNase A solution to 180 µL lysate (final 1×), rotate at 4 °C for 60 min on a rotary mixer (NRC‑20D or equivalent).

steps.title: Bind lysate to Protein G beads
steps.instruction: Wash 7 µL Dynabeads™ Protein G with 200 µL wash buffer, place on magnetic rack, discard supernatant. Transfer the 200 µL antibody‑lysate mixture to the beads, rotate at 4 °C for 40 min on the rotary mixer. Magnetically separate beads and keep 10 µL supernatant as unbound fraction for western blot; add 2 µL 6× SDS‑dye, incubate 95 °C 5 min, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Wash immunoprecipitated beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 1 mL wash buffer, transfer to a new siliconized 1.5 mL tube, magnetically separate and discard supernatant. Repeat this wash three times, avoiding bead drying.

steps.title: Elute ribosome complexes
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL SDS buffer to beads, resuspend, magnetically separate, and transfer the clear supernatant (eluted fraction) to a new tube. Add 6 µL 6× SDS‑dye, incubate 95 °C 5 min, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Load 1.5 µL molecular weight marker and 5 µL each sample (input, unbound, eluted) onto an e‑PAGEL 5 %–20 % precast gel in Tris‑glycine SDS running buffer; run at 180 V for 50–60 min at RT. Activate PVDF membrane in ethanol briefly, then soak in 1× EzFastBlot transfer buffer. Perform wet transfer at 7 mA/cm² (≈441 mA for a 6 × 9 cm membrane) for 15 min at RT.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane in 10 mL 1 % BSA/TBST for ≥30 min at RT with gentle agitation (rocker speed 3).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare primary antibody mixes (Table 2) by diluting each antibody in 2 mL 1 % BSA/TBST (e.g., 1 µL anti‑P0 for 1/2000). Add 0.2 µL ProClin 950 to each 2 mL mix for long‑term storage (1/10 000). Place membrane (protein‑side inward) in 50 mL tube containing the appropriate primary antibody solution, rotate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash membrane three times with 10 mL TBST for ≥10 min each at RT on rocker (speed 3).

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare secondary antibody mixes (Table 3) by diluting each secondary in 2 mL 1 % BSA/TBST (0.4 µL each for 1/5000). Place membrane in 50 mL tube with the appropriate secondary solution, rotate at RT for ≥30 min.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash membrane three times with 10 mL TBST for ≥10 min each at RT on rocker (speed 3).

steps.title: Detect signals
steps.instruction: Turn on ImageQuant LAS 4000 mini, incubate membrane with HRP‑based western blot substrate (e.g., ECL Select) on plastic wrap, place membrane in the LAS 4000 chamber and acquire images. Invert membrane twice to ensure even substrate coverage; photograph membrane with markers for reference.

steps.title: Seed HEK293 cells for 4sU labeling
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁶ HEK293 cells in 10 mL DMEM (high glucose) with 10 % FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin in a 10 cm dish; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified.

steps.title: Prepare 4sU labeling mix
steps.instruction: For each 10 cm dish, combine 180 µL serum‑free DMEM, 10 µL 200 mM 4‑thiouridine (final 200 µM), and 10 µL either DMSO (control) or 1 mM thapsigargin (final 0.1 % v/v or 1 µM). Mix gently.

steps.title: Label cells and lyse
steps.instruction: Add the 200 µL labeling mix to the 10 mL culture medium, incubate 3 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Aspirate medium, add 1 mL ice‑cold 1 % Triton X‑100 lysis buffer, shake dish, transfer lysate to a 1.5 mL tube, and centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. Keep supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare 10× antibody‑RNasin mix
steps.instruction: Combine 34 µL freshly prepared 1 % Triton X‑100 lysis buffer, 4 µL anti‑ribosomal P0/P1/P2 mAb (0.2 µg/µL), and 12 µL RNasin Plus (10 units/µL) to make the 10× antibody solution for ribosome‑bound RNA.

steps.title: Process cytosolic RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL supernatant to a new tube, add 500 µL ISOGEN II supplemented with 1 mM DTT, mix, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate ribosome‑bound RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer 450 µL supernatant to a new tube, add 50 µL 10× antibody‑RNasin mix (final 1×), rotate 60 min at 4 °C. Wash 28 µL Dynabeads™ Protein G with 1 mL wash buffer, place on magnet, discard wash. Add the antibody‑lysate mixture to the beads, rotate 40 min at 4 °C. Magnetically separate beads, wash three times with 1 mL wash buffer (as above).

steps.title: Elute ribosome‑bound RNA
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ISOGEN II with 1 mM DTT to the washed beads, resuspend, magnetically separate, and transfer supernatant to a new tube. Add 200 µL nuclease‑free water with 1 mM DTT, mix, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: RNA purification (dark conditions)
steps.instruction: Thaw RNA samples on ice, keep protected from light. Incubate at 37 °C for 5 min, vortex 15 s, stand 10 min at RT, centrifuge 20 000 × g 10 min at RT. Transfer 500 µL supernatant to a new tube, add 500 µL 2‑propanol with 1 mM DTT, vortex 15 s, centrifuge 20 000 × g 15 min at RT. Discard supernatant, add 500 µL 70 % ethanol with 1 mM DTT, centrifuge 20 000 × g 3 min at RT; repeat ethanol wash once. Discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 15 µL nuclease‑free water with 1 mM DTT, measure concentration (Nanodrop, 260/280 ≈2.0).

steps.title: Prepare DMSO/NaPO₄ solution
steps.instruction: Mix 25 µL DMSO with 5 µL 0.5 M NaPO₄ pH 8.0 (see Recipes) per sample; centrifuge and keep the clear supernatant for alkylation.

steps.title: Alkylate 4sU‑labeled RNA
steps.instruction: For ≤5 µg RNA (≤100 ng/µL), combine: RNA volume (≤5 µg), nuclease‑free water to bring total volume to 15 µL, 5 µL 100 mM IAA (final 10 mM), and 30 µL DMSO/NaPO₄ solution. Incubate 15 min at 50 °C (DTU‑1CN). Add 1 µL 1 M DTT, 1 µL 20 mg/mL glycogen, 5 µL 3 M NaOAc, and 125 µL ethanol. Vortex 15 s, centrifuge 20 000 × g 30 min at 4 °C. Wash pellet with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 20 000 × g 3 min at 4 °C; repeat wash once at RT. Discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 25 µL nuclease‑free water (or 12.5 µL if input ≤2.5 µg). Measure concentration (Nanodrop, 260/280 ≈2.0).

steps.title: Assess RNA quality with MultiNA
steps.instruction: Prepare MultiNA buffer per sample: 63.2 µL separation buffer, 0.8 µL 1/100 diluted SYBR Green II, 16 µL formamide (total 80 µL). In 0.2 mL PCR tubes, add 5 µL RNA marker solution, 5 µL RNA storage solution (blank) or 4 µL RNA storage solution + 1 µL RNA sample (RNA sample). Incubate tubes at 65 °C for 5 min, place on ice. Load buffer tubes and PCR tubes onto MultiNA instrument, run using MultiNA Control Software. Analyze electropherograms for size distribution and 28S/18S ratio.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing library
steps.instruction: Use the QuantSeq 3′ mRNA‑Seq Library Prep Kit FWD (Lexogen) following the manufacturer’s protocol, inputting 500 ng of alkylated RNA per reaction.

steps.title: Quantify libraries with Qubit
steps.instruction: Prepare Qubit dsDNA HS working solution: 50 µL Component A + 0.25 µL Component B per sample (or 1 mL/5 µL for 20 samples). In a black 96‑well plate, add 50 µL working solution to 1 µL Qubit standard (C or D) or cDNA sample. Measure fluorescence at 485 nm excitation / 530 nm emission on a SpectraMax reader; repeat each plate ≥3 times for stability. Calculate library concentration.

steps.title: Pool and sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Pool libraries in equimolar amounts in a 1.5 mL tube. Sequence on an Illumina platform (HiSeq, NovaSeq preferred) aiming for ≥1 × 10⁶ counted T→C reads per sample; use single‑end reads (≥150 bp) for optimal detection of T>C conversions.
